provenance.purpose: Common religious/theological vocabulary and stock phrasing, corpus-derived, used by closeness_check.py's SENTINEL_VOCAB exemption category (PLAN.md #45 Phase 6) so shared cross-teacher boilerplate phrasing does not drive a false paraphrase-closeness flag.
provenance.dispatch_lineage: Dispatch A: corpus-frequency n-gram mining over the full in-scope corpus, 6528 raw candidates. Dispatch A2: filtered the 6528 down to this 1210 by removing generic-English collocations and identifiable scripture text (below). This file is a direct copy/transform of the Alex-blessed Dispatch A2 output (common_religious_vocab_filtered_a2.json) -- no re-derivation, re-extraction, or re-filtering performed here.

filter_B_scripture_exclusion.name: standalone-phrase verse matcher, adapted from closeness_check._find_quote_span
filter_B_scripture_exclusion.disclosed_anchor4_false_positive_residua: No citation precondition exists for this standalone-phrase adaptation (unlike production _find_quote_span, which only runs this check in a window around an already-validated citation). At anchor=4 (matched=4, no extension beyond the bare anchor) -- the weakest-evidence tier -- 1199/5269 (22.8%) of all scripture-exclusions fall here; of those, 1048 (87.4% of the tier) show no archaic-KJV-register word at all, a proxy for elevated false-positive suspicion. Hand-verified concrete false positives wrongly EXCLUDED as 'scripture' by this tier and therefore NOT present in this phrase list even though they are genuine stock theological phrasing, not Bible quotations: 'the outpouring of the holy spirit', 'the guidance of the holy spirit', 'the agency of the holy spirit' (all three matched Acts 2:38 on 'of the Holy Spirit' + filler only), 'the creator of heaven and earth' (matched Ezra 5:11 on 'heaven and earth' only), 'is one of the most important' (matched Mark 14:20 on 'is one of the' only), 'and this is the reason why' (matched Isaiah 28:12 on 'this is the' only). Disclosed, not fixed -- these phrases are simply absent from this list, a false-negative residual on the exemption side (fewer phrases masked than ideal), not a false-positive risk to the metric.

provenance.verses_translation_caveat: Ground truth for the scripture-exclusion pass is the live `verses` table: 31,098/31,098 rows are translation='WEB' -- no KJV/NIV/NASB/ESV rows exist. This corpus's classic commentators (Adam Clarke, Matthew Henry, John Wesley, Jonathan Edwards, etc.) overwhelmingly quote KJV, whose archaic register and specific word choices frequently diverge from WEB wording. Net effect: some real KJV-register scripture quotations survive filter B undetected and remain in this 1210-phrase list as if they were generic vocabulary (a disclosed, not-fixed gap -- see Dispatch A2's methodology notes for hand-verified concrete examples: 'we see through a glass darkly' [1 Cor 13:12], 'gird up the loins of your mind' [1 Pet 1:13], 'the care of all the churches' [2 Cor 11:28]).
